summary: Timpani (Tubular Classics, openDAW's own DX7 voice): drums
group: Tubular Classics sounds, drums (DX7 voices on a Tubular)
body: Good for FM percussion: one note per hit (pitch changes the tone). Usual in: electro, 80s, cinematic.

Loads the whole voice (all six operators, envelopes, algorithm) onto a Tubular: a track's own Tubular, or a new Tubular track when no track is given. To change it after, set Tubular's fields (catalog paths) with the instrument op or a script.

track.about: a track whose instrument is a Tubular; leave out to add a new track
